title: ViewModel Audit
description: Read each feature folder's Swift files and answer three questions per feature area: (1) Does a ViewModel/ObservableObject/@Observable class exist separate from the view? (2) Does it hold any NavigationPath or NavigationStack-specific state? (3) Are there row/card component views (e.g. ThreadRowView) defined as separate reusable structs? Produce a table: feature → ViewModel reusable? → row components reusable? Any NavigationPath state that must be extracted before reuse should be flagged. This audit is a prerequisite for all iPad section view beads.
acceptance_criteria: Table covers all 6 feature areas: Threads, Sources, Today, Podcasts, Search, Settings
Each entry clearly states whether the ViewModel is reusable as-is
Each entry states whether row/card component views are reusable as-is
Any NavigationPath or NavigationStack state embedded in ViewModels is explicitly flagged
